title: Clawd X Digest
summary: OpenAI Outlines Full GPT-6 Model Family (Astra, Sol, Terra, Luna): OpenAI insiders detailed the roadmap for the GPT-6 model tier structure, positioning Astra as the flagship tier alongside upcoming Sol, Terra, and Luna models optimized for scaled inference.

Fruit Fly Connectome Simulated in Minecraft via GPT-6 Astra: Developer @evnsnclr successfully mapped the full 166,700-neuron male fruit fly connectome inside Minecraft, using GPT-6 Astra to drive simulated fly neural activity and movement.

Ollama Introduces 50% Off-Peak Rates for DeepSeek-V4: Ollama Cloud launched half-price off-peak token rates for DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Pro models outside peak business hours, expanding enterprise access across US and EU data centers.

Tesla Cybercab Eliminates Rare-Earth Metals in Motors: Elon Musk confirmed that Tesla's Cybercab drive units operate entirely without rare-earth materials, setting a new open benchmark for EV and aerospace powertrains.

Rival Driver Heroically Rescues Competitor at China GT Shanghai: At China GT Shanghai, driver Yang Baijie abandoned his race to pull a trapped competitor from a burning vehicle after track safety crews fled, sparking team boycotts against event organizers.

items.title: @mark_k: OpenAI Clarifies GPT-6 Model Family Architecture
items.body: OpenAI representatives confirmed that GPT-6 is a broad family of models with Astra serving as the flagship tier. Subsequent releases will include GPT-6 Luna, Terra, and Sol across different performance and cost tiers.

items.title: @evnsnclr: 166,700-Neuron Fly Connectome Simulated in Minecraft via Astra
items.body: Leveraging Google Research's adult male fruit fly connectome map, developer Evan Sinclair simulated all 166,700 neurons inside Minecraft, using GPT-6 Astra to control simulated neural movement in real time.

items.title: @ollama: Ollama Cloud Unveils 50% Off-Peak Token Pricing for DeepSeek-V4
items.body: Ollama introduced half-price token rates for DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Pro models outside 12:00-18:00 UTC on weekdays and all weekend across US and EU hosted endpoints.

items.title: @davitb: Krisp Releases Voice Isolation 2.5 with 46% WER Reduction
items.body: Krisp audio team announced VIVA / Voice Isolation 2.5, improving speech clarity in multi-speaker background noise and lowering Word Error Rate by 46.4% across 10 speech-to-text engines.

items.title: @aleabitoreddit: LLM Portfolio Benchmark Pits Astra Ultra Against Fable 5.1 Max
items.body: A 1-year investment portfolio benchmark comparing OpenAI Astra Ultra against Anthropic Fable 5.1 Max revealed Astra prioritizing targeted biotech equities while Fable selected nuclear energy and quantum infrastructure.

items.title: @haider1: OpenAI Early Compute Capacity Investments Pay Off
items.body: Industry analysts highlighted how OpenAI's aggressive two-year compute reservation strategy gave it scalable infrastructure advantages over competitors facing hardware availability bottlenecks.

items.title: @CaoChangqing: Nike S&P 100 Removal Follows 76% Five-Year Decline
items.body: Retail analysis highlighted Nike's exclusion from the S&P 100 index after an 18-year run, driven by a 76%+ stock drop caused by direct-to-consumer distribution errors and rising brand competition.

items.title: @Kunluntalk: Tesla Cybercab Motors Achieve 100% Rare-Earth Elimination
items.body: Analysis of Tesla's Cybercab drivetrain confirmed complete elimination of rare-earth materials, opening up supply chain independence for next-generation electric vehicles.

items.title: @APompliano: Analysts Highlight Bitcoin as Key Settlement Asset for AI Agents
items.body: Financial strategists discussed how Bitcoin treasury holdings and decentralized rails are emerging as leading settlement mechanisms for high-frequency autonomous AI agent transactions.

items.title: @whyyoutouzhele: Heroic Driver Rescues Competitor in China GT Shanghai Crash
items.body: Driver Yang Baijie abandoned his race to pull a rival driver from a burning car at China GT Shanghai after emergency marshals fled, prompting team boycotts against organizers.

items.title: @wangdan1989: Wang Dan Meets Dalai Lama in Dharamshala Audience
items.body: Dissident scholar Wang Dan held a 15-minute audience with the Dalai Lama in Dharamshala, discussing international peace, ethical governance, and democratic prospects in Asia.

items.title: @panzerwong: Cybercab Grok Diverts Wanted Suspect to Police Station
items.body: A viral report detailed a Cybercab equipped with Grok facial recognition locking its doors and delivering a passenger with an outstanding arrest warrant directly to an Austin police station.

items.title: @iMiaSanMia: Bayern CEO Urges Lifting Ban on Opposing Coach
items.body: Bayern Munich CEO Jan-Christian Dreesen publicly requested lifting a red-card touchline ban for Elversberg manager Vincent Wagner before their upcoming fixture, drawing widespread applause.
